title: Finite canonical pullback carries the local germ formula to Theta
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, Y locally Noetherian, F coherent, y∈Y and p,n≥0 [def-weil-proper-morphism,pqf-def-locnoeth,pqf-def-coherent]. Let r:formalFunctionsLocalCohomology(f,y,F,p)→H^p(X_n,F_n) be A-linear whose underlying function equals formalFunctionsFinitePullback [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-finite-pullback]. For every A-linear a:formalFunctionsStalk(f,y,F,p)→formalFunctionsLocalCohomology(f,y,F,p) satisfying IsFormalFunctionsLocalComparison [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-local-comparison], r composed with a satisfies IsFormalFunctionsTheta at level n [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. There is no quotient-system isomorphism in this statement.

proof.text: Choose a resolution K of F′. The local-spectrum map c:Spec O_y→Y and its pullback g′ are flat, so for each neighbourhood V of y obtain local open choices E from the open-choice existence theorem. Fix arbitrary finite-level choices D and a class xi. E.source and D.source are augmentation-preserving identifications with the restriction of the same I; their pinned sections maps identify resolutionSectionClass with the same canonical class in R^p f_*F(V). This also follows by homotopy uniqueness of comparison maps. Hence the germ appearing in ha agrees with the germ in the desired Theta formula.

proof.text: Let U=f inverse V, U′=g′ inverse U and W=i_n inverse U. The projection equality i′_n followed by g′=i_n identifies W with i′_n inverse U′. Restrict the finite h-map to W. Its adjunction equation together with the unit squares for E.psi and D.psi shows that composing the local pullback h-map with the restricted finite h-map equals D.psi. Use cohomology composition and the restriction-unit square to identify restriction to W after formalFunctionsFinitePullback with this same composite. Apply this identity to ha on the common germ; replace r by canonical pullback using hr. The result is exactly the defining equality for IsFormalFunctionsTheta, for every I,J,V,D,xi. No invertibility or existence theorem for a is needed. In degree zero these are section pullbacks; zero F or empty fibres give zero maps.
